segments.name: cryptocurrency mining
segments.description: Self-mines cryptocurrencies at subsidiary-owned mining farms and operates mining pools for third-party participants, earning coin rewards.
segments.evidence: the Company operated in two primary reportable segments, which were the cryptocurrency mining, which included mining revenue and mining pool revenue, and the sale of mining machines.

segments.name: sale of mining machines
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells proprietary ASIC-chip mining machines to distributors, mining companies and individual miners.
segments.evidence: In April 2023, we started selling mining machines designed by us, installed with our proprietary ASIC chips, to customers.

revenueModel.text: Mining machine customers and hosting clients pay us for machines and capacity, pool participants pay fees, and we earn cryptocurrency rewards from our own mining.
revenueModel.evidence: we generate income by receiving crypto coins as rewards and deducting a percentage of such rewards as pool fees from payouts to pool participants.

changes.text: In 2025 the company determined to wind down its mining pool business.
changes.evidence: we have determined that the mining pool business will be wound down and have proactively taken steps to implement this rundown of the business segment.
